Action items from a rev-rec perspective:
- Don’t recognize the $149,980 as revenue for May; post the clearing journal to move funds to Contract Holdback Liability (2408.12).
- Create a rev-rec memo for the May close referencing Deal ID ACME-492 and include the lookup to the contract section.
- If Acme confirms final acceptance later, we’ll recognize revenue pro-rata (or release liability) and book a recognition journal in the period of acceptance.

I attached a journal template for reclass entries (journal_template_reclass.csv) and linked the revenue-mapping folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1fAKEd-REVENUE-MAPPING

I can draft the journal and the memo today; Karthik, please reach out to Acme for the formal remittance/PO copy so we have audit evidence.
